Whether you’re building digital humans for film, gaming, VR, or virtual production, photogrammetry provides the realism, accuracy, and efficiency that traditional modeling methods simply can’t match. In this in-depth guide, we’ll break down what photogrammetry is, how it works, and why it’s such a critical component of modern 3D character scanning pipelines.
